HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Arum. d.]
Shooting pains in right ear at 8 A. M., half an hour after breakfast, transient, but frequent, leaving a feeling of fulness and slight aching in middle ear ; next day changed to left ear.
Shooting pains in right ear, sometimes very severe ; deep shooting frequently, and for ten, fifteen minutes, only occasionally in left.
Mucus in left eustachian tube. See 13.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Arum. d.]
Sneezing. θ Asthma Millari.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Arum. d.]
Peculiar acrid sensation in mouth and throat.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Arum. d.]
Dryness and smarting in throat, rawness and fulness, not painful, but annoying, attracting constant attention.
Hawking.
Continual disposition to clear throat by swallowing and coughing.
Throat raw and tender.
Constant rawness of throat ; constant coughing, with mucus in morning.
A feeling of dryness and smarting, kind of rawness with a sense of fulness, not really painful, but sufficiently annoying, it attracts constant attention, and produces a continual disposition to clear throat by swallowing, coughing or hawking.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Arum. d.]
Penis flaccid and relaxed.
Chronic pruritus scroti of twelve years' standing.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Arum. d.]
Hoarseness ; expectorates thick mucus.
Excess of mucus in larynx (See 13) ; increased soreness of larynx and great disposition to cough.
As if larynx were partly obstructed. θ Asthma Millari.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Arum. d.]
Awakes about midnight with great oppression of breathing, a kind of asthmatic attack, soon passing off.
Paroxysms of dyspnœa occurring sometimes, with much aching in chest, and always with considerable secretion of mucus in larynx and trachea.
Asthmatic attacks at night, from a cold, which had resisted Colchic. and Ant. tart.
Oppressed asthmatic breathing, as if larynx was partly obstructed. θ Asthma Millari.
At midnight suddenly seized with labored breathing, followed in 15 or 20 minutes by croup-like cough ; coughs until exhausted (about 3 minutes), then violent inspirations and no expirations until lungs are expanded to their fullest extent, when breathing ceases, feces would be expelled, cold sweat breaks out all over body ; this breathless condition lasts from 1 to 12 minutes, and is followed by an interval of from half to three quarters of an hour, in which there is considerable rattling of mucus in larynx and some in lungs ; three or four attacks up to 2 or 3 A. M. θ Asthma Millari.
   

COUGH. [27] [Arum. d.]
Expectoration thick, heavy, yellowish-white, with continuation of a violent cough.
Annoying cough, with rattling in larynx.
Croupy cough, with hoarseness and rawness of throat, during an epidemic influenza.
Hoarse, croupy cough, with sore throat, rattling laryngeal respiration, and considerable swelling of air passages, threatening suffocation ; child, æt 3.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Arum. d.]
Boy, æt. 4 years and 9 months. θ Asthma Millari.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Arum. d.]
Aqua chlor. relieved spasms of glottis, but prolonged the attacks. θ Asthma Millari.
